metadata.r2_compute_note: in-sample, most specific factor; judge accuracy on held-out data

calibration_coverage.note: Factors apply node > device type > global. A device type without samples uses the global factor, so calibration cannot change decisions between nodes of uncalibrated types.

hardware_measurements.reason: Run scripts/measure_hardware.py on the cluster and pass its output via --physical-measurements.

partition_baselines.caveat: Model-based: every latency here is predicted by the (calibrated) cost model on synthetic node specs and analytic Qwen2.5 decoder-layer profiles. These numbers compare decisions under one shared evaluator; they are not hardware measurements.

scenario_grid.objective: single-request prefill latency = sum of stage compute + activation transfers

partition_baselines.latency_ratio_definition: method latency / orchest_subset_dp latency in the same scenario (feasible only)

historical_reproduction_notes.historical_mechanism: Synthetic Gaussian noise random.gauss(0, 0.02) over repeated simulated runs
historical_reproduction_notes.scientific_takeaway: Zero algorithmic regret proves discrete optimization correctness of the solver, while prediction error measures cost model fidelity and physical regret measures hardware performance.
